text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the break, I saw Espoir City. She 
seemed even more cheerful than usual.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I heard you'd be sending a care package, 
but... A lollipop, of all things?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Melon, lemon, strawberry... You still 
remember what flavors you liked as a kid?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what flavor should I go with 
today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to have spent a delightfully 
relaxing day off. I quietly walked away 
without disturbing her.
